title: We Speak Two Languages / 我们说两种语言

content.alt: Children speaking different languages around the world

sentences.chinese: 你说什么语言？

sentences.english: Do you speak one language or more than one?
sentences.chinese: 你说一种语言还是多种语言？

sentences.english: People who speak two languages are bilingual.
sentences.chinese: 说两种语言的人称为双语者。
我的名字是安德烈。
我住在加拿大魁北克。
我说两种语言。
我说法语和英语。

sentences.english: My teachers use French and English in many classes, such as reading and social studies.
sentences.chinese: 我的老师在许多课上使用法语和英语，比如阅读和社会研究。
我的名字是曼努埃尔。
我住在纽约。

sentences.english: I am Hispanic, and I speak two languages.
sentences.chinese: 我是西班牙裔，我说两种语言。
我说西班牙语和英语。

content.alt: Grandparents teaching grandson Spanish songs and guitar

sentences.english: My grandparents moved to New York City from Spain.
sentences.chinese: 我的祖父母从西班牙搬到了纽约市。

sentences.english: My grandfather taught me to sing Spanish songs and play guitar.
sentences.chinese: 我的祖父教我唱西班牙歌曲和弹吉他。

sentences.english: My name is Waya, and I am Cherokee.
sentences.chinese: 我的名字是瓦亚，我是切罗基人。

sentences.english: Waya means 'wolf' in the Cherokee language.
sentences.chinese: 瓦亚在切罗基语中的意思是'狼'。
我说两种语言。
我说切罗基语和英语。

content.alt: Cherokee family using special keyboard with Cherokee syllabary

sentences.english: The Cherokees are a Native American tribe. At home, my family uses special keyboards. We can write in English and in Cherokee.
sentences.chinese: 切罗基人是美洲原住民部落。在家里，我的家人使用特殊的键盘。我们可以用英语和切罗基语书写。

sentences.english: My name is Doli, and I am Navajo.
sentences.chinese: 我的名字是多莉，我是纳瓦霍人。
多莉在纳瓦霍语中的意思是'蓝鸟'。
我说两种语言。
我说英语和纳瓦霍语。

sentences.english: My grandfather used the Navajo language to keep U.S. secrets safe during World War II.
sentences.chinese: 我的祖父在二战期间使用纳瓦霍语保护美国的机密安全。
我的名字是内莉。

sentences.english: Nelli means 'truth' in Nahuatl, the language of the Aztecs.
sentences.chinese: 内莉在纳瓦特尔语（阿兹特克人的语言）中的意思是'真理'。
我说两种语言。
我说纳瓦特尔语和西班牙语。

sentences.english: Chocolate was first made by the Aztecs in Mexico. Chocolate is a Nahuatl word.
sentences.chinese: 巧克力最初由墨西哥的阿兹特克人制作。巧克力是一个纳瓦特尔语词汇。

sentences.english: My name is Itati. I live in Paraguay.
sentences.chinese: 我的名字是伊塔蒂。我住在巴拉圭。
伊塔蒂在瓜拉尼语中的意思是'白色的石头'。
我说两种语言。
我说瓜拉尼语和西班牙语。

sentences.english: Guarani is a Native American language. It is spoken by most of the people of Paraguay. Over seven million people in the world speak Guarani.
sentences.chinese: 瓜拉尼语是一种美洲原住民语言。巴拉圭大部分人都说这种语言。全世界有超过七百万人说瓜拉尼语。

sentences.english: My name is Inti, which means 'sun' in Quechua.
sentences.chinese: 我的名字是印提，在克丘亚语中的意思是'太阳'。
我说两种语言。
我说克丘亚语和西班牙语。

sentences.english: Quechua is the language the Incas spoke.
sentences.chinese: 克丘亚语是印加人所说的语言。

sentences.english: My mother, grandmother, and I speak Quechua as we weave.
sentences.chinese: 我的母亲、祖母和我在编织时说克丘亚语。
我们说两种语言。
我们是双语者！
你是双语者吗？

sentences.english: Being bilingual makes you close to two worlds.
sentences.chinese: 双语让你贴近两个世界。
